newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy mostly up, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy mostly up, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soy basis values rose one to two cents a bushel on Friday while corn were mostly steady amid featureless dealings, grain dealers said.
Hard and soft red winter wheat values were mostly flat.
"It is very quiet today (Friday)," one U.S. exporter said, referring to the lack of export activity.
One wheat dealer said there was some producer selling. The market was also awaiting results of the Pakistan tender for 450,000 tonnes of Australian and/or U.S. wheat this weekend, dealers said.
